title: Make task-local migration resolvability-aware and exhaustively validated
objective: Thoroughly test sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up across every existing work item in the WI-0000 through WI-0018 range using an isolated work tree, prevent migration of references that cannot resolve as task-local references, and report every unresolvable candidate explicitly without modifying the source repository.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository uses main for active work and has a local master release ref from WI-0019; this work item is planning and validation work only.

request.text:
Perhaps we should test migrate up by up migrating all of the work items in this repository, 0 -> 18 in a work tree and discard the changes after they've been validated so we have more confidence in the command.

Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to thoroughly test and address migration issues. The migrator should avoid migrating references that aren't resolvable as a task local reference and the migration output should indicate what was unresolvable.

Commit the new work item.

scope.name: resolvability-aware-migration
scope.description: Before rewriting a recognized legacy task-local or task-qualified reference, resolve its containing task/document context and confirm that the canonical target exists at the selected collection/id path.
scope.reason: A syntactically recognizable reference can still point to a nonexistent collection, entity, or unsupported context and must not be rewritten speculatively.

scope.name: unresolvable-reference-reporting
scope.description: Extend migration output with deterministic unresolvable-reference entries containing the source path, original reference, scope/context, and reason while preserving the original bytes.
scope.reason: Operators need actionable evidence for references that were intentionally not migrated rather than silent skips.

scope.name: all-work-items-worktree-rehearsal
scope.description: Run migration rehearsal coverage across every existing work item in the WI-0000 through WI-0018 range inside a temporary Git worktree, inspect the resulting diff, and forcibly discard the worktree after validation.
scope.reason: The command must be tested against heterogeneous historical records without dirtying the authoritative source worktree.

scope.name: migration-regression-contract
scope.description: Cover valid local/qualified references, nonexistent entities, wrong collection mappings, repository-state references, missing current-task context, malformed content, no-op behavior, sibling isolation, and deterministic response/schema behavior.
scope.reason: The observed WI-0011 depth-2 failures span migration semantics, resolver context, and reporting boundaries.

scope.name: per-task-test-gates
scope.description: Require a complete passing unit-test gate before every implementation and validation task commit.
scope.reason: The changes affect migration decisions, persisted records, resolver behavior, worktree safety, and response contracts.

nonGoals.name: source-worktree-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not leave migration changes in the authoritative source worktree during exhaustive rehearsal; all bulk migration validation must occur in a disposable temporary worktree.
nonGoals.reason: The request explicitly requires discarding rehearsal changes after validation.

nonGoals.name: speculative-reference-rewrite
nonGoals.description: Do not rewrite a candidate when its canonical task-local target cannot be resolved or its context is unsupported.
nonGoals.reason: Unresolvable references must remain unchanged and be reported.

nonGoals.name: remote-resolution
nonGoals.description: Do not contact remote repositories, providers, or registries while resolving migration candidates.
nonGoals.reason: The rehearsal and command remain local and deterministic.

nonGoals.name: release-version-change
nonGoals.description: Do not bump the package version or create a release/tag as part of this migration-confidence work item.
nonGoals.reason: The request is for migration correctness and disposable rehearsal evidence only.

items.name: resolvable-only-rewrite
items.description: The migrator must rewrite only legacy references whose canonical task-local target resolves in the containing task/document context.
items.reason: Syntactic recognition alone caused incorrect mappings such as result/results/R-001 and intent/testCaseRefs/TC-* in WI-0011.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Resolvable legacy local and task-qualified references migrate to exact canonical collection/id paths; nonexistent entities, wrong collections, and unsupported contexts remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Work-item-local references and repository-state references are either resolved by explicit supported rules or reported unresolvable without speculative rewriting.

items.name: unresolvable-output
items.description: Migration output must explicitly report every recognized-but-unresolvable candidate with deterministic path/reference/reason data.
items.reason: Silent omission makes bulk migration results unauditable.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The response schema includes an unresolvable collection with stable entries for source path, original reference, context/scope, reason, and preserved status.
Unresolvable entries are deterministic across repeated runs and do not appear as changed replacements.

items.name: exhaustive-worktree-rehearsal
items.description: Validation must rehearse migration for every existing work item in the WI-0000 through WI-0018 range inside a temporary Git worktree and discard the worktree after inspection.
items.reason: Historical records vary in task schemas, legacy references, and result shapes; one fixture is insufficient confidence.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The rehearsal enumerates WI-0000 through WI-0018, migrates every existing work item, records changed/unresolvable results, checks sibling/out-of-range isolation, and removes the temporary worktree with no source-worktree changes.

The rehearsal covers WI-0011 specifically and demonstrates that the previously observed result/results, testCaseRefs, repository-state, and current-task-context categories are either corrected or reported.

items.name: resolver-context-contract
items.description: Depth-limited resolution and migration validation must preserve or explicitly represent current-task context when evaluating task-local references.
items.reason: Canonical #intent/... references encountered during recursive expansion currently fail because child resolution loses the containing task context.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tests distinguish resolvable task-local references with context from standalone references that cannot be resolved, and the migration report identifies context absence rather than silently skipping it.

items.name: task-commit-test-gate
items.description: Every WI-0020 implementation and validation task must record and pass the complete unit-test command before its task commit.
items.reason: The work crosses migration semantics, resolver context, response schema, and disposable worktree orchestration.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each task result records a passed full test execution and the repository suite is 100% passing at every task commit.
